description: battery-optimizer resident shadow service (Phase C): readiness, inputs, solves, plan and shadow-vs-native comparison.

panels.title: Ready
panels.description: 1 when every input is fresh and an unexpired plan was made recently. Readiness probes use /health/live, so this metric is the readiness signal.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: Service version, SOC source (simulated until the battery is mapped in Home Assistant) and mode (shadow only).

panels.title: Not-ready reasons
panels.description: One line per active reason (bounded set).

panels.title: HA failures by stage
panels.description: Connect, auth, subscribe, get_states, heartbeat, disconnect, protocol.

panels.title: Input age
panels.description: Seconds since Home Assistant last reported the value. Freshness limits are in service.yaml (grid power 300 s).

panels.title: Price horizon
panels.description: How far ahead PVPC prices are published (the plan horizon ends there).

panels.title: Load history
panels.description: Refreshed daily from the long-term Prometheus.

panels.title: Solves by result
panels.description: Hourly count. Anything other than ok is worth a look.

panels.title: Current intent power
panels.description: Shadow intent only: nothing is ever sent to the battery.

panels.title: Virtual battery SOC
panels.description: Open-loop replay of the service's own decisions against measured load (soc_source: simulated).

panels.title: Shadow slots by decision
panels.description: Closed slots in the last 6 h by decision (intent, no_plan, plan_expired, not_ready, not_observed).

panels.title: Battery energy: planned vs actual
panels.description: Last 24 h. Actual stays 0 until battery telemetry is mapped in Home Assistant.

panels.title: Cost since start: native vs counterfactual
panels.description: Pretax energy cost since the service started; PVPC can be negative. Before commissioning the 'native' side is the house without a battery, so this estimates the battery's value but does not satisfy exit gate C.

panels.title: SOC window violations
panels.description: Decisions that, applied to the measured SOC, would leave the configured SOC window.

title: Battery optimizer shadow service
